mapper.select: SELECT id, corpid, business_code AS businessCode, config_json AS configJson, del, add_time AS addTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_business_config WHERE corpid = #{corpid} AND business_code = #{businessCode} AND del = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_business_config (corpid, business_code, config_json, del, add_time, update_time) VALUES (#{corpid}, #{businessCode}, #{configJson}, #{del}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_business_config SET del = 1, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE corpid = #{corpid} AND business_code = #{businessCode} AND del = 0
